decisions.reason: The custom earmold for in-ear systems builds on the firm's core competence in hearing acoustics and custom ear impressions, so its investment and strategic fit argue for persistence despite its low visibility.

The EARsleeve has its own page and is publicly branded by Dreve as delivering the 'ultimate hearing experience', a visible commitment central to the firm's audiology direction that management would defend even if early results disappoint.

The vacuum thermoforming unit is an equipment line with substantial development investment and its own web page, and it fits the firm's established dental and lab equipment business, so slow initial sales would likely be attributed to market ramp-up rather than prompting withdrawal.
